sections.section_title: OTG host periodic transmit FIFO size register (OTG_HPTXFSIZ)
sections.text_helper: Section 73.14.21 "OTG host periodic transmit FIFO size register (OTG_HPTXFSIZ)" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3821.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x100
Reset value: 0x04000800
Bits 31:16 PTXFSIZ[15:0]: Host periodic Tx FIFO depth
This value is in terms of 32-bit words.
Minimum value is 16
Bits 15:0 PTXSA[15:0]: Host periodic Tx FIFO start address
This field configures the memory start address for periodic transmit FIFO RAM.
